# Spoolway

> Spoolway ("Spoolway: Clear the Path") is a calm puzzle game for iPhone (iOS 15 or later), coming soon to the App Store. Spools stand on a wooden board, and a spool can leave only when a clear path leads up to the top row; every spool taken opens the way for the ones behind it. Each spool then knits its colour into one of 120 pictures of Vietnam, from Hội An lanterns and a bowl of phở to lotus flowers, Hạ Long Bay and bánh mì. It is free to download, plays fully offline and has no ads and no account.

- Every level can be beaten without paying. Each win earns 40 coins; optional coin packs (500, 1,200, 2,800 and 6,500 coins) are sold as in-app purchases.
- Special spools: ice, roped pairs, mystery spools and dispensers. Boosters: +1 Slot, Hand and Scissors.
- Colour-blind mode adds a symbol to every yarn colour. The game is in English.
- Progress is stored only on the device. The game collects no personal data and sends no analytics.
- © 2026 Luong Nguyen.
